title: Toggle 1.3× crop mode

steps.text: MENU → Photo shooting menu → Image area → Choose image area
Pick 1.3× (18×12) — the 55-200 now frames like 390mm equivalent
Burst rises to 7 fps and the AF points cover nearly the whole frame

tip: It's a crop, not magnification — same pixels you'd get cropping later, but AF coverage and fps improve. Great for whales.
